{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id and keep the highest sample_seq
# First, verify that patient_id is not unique per row
print("Number of unique patient_id values:", trial_df['patient_id'].nunique())
print("Total number of rows:", len(trial_df))

# Keep the row with the highest sample_seq for each patient_id
trial_df = trial_df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Verify that now each patient_id is unique
print("After deduplication - unique patient_id count:", trial_df['patient_id'].nunique())
print("Remaining rows:", len(trial_df))"}
